tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page canvas; the ground the ambient field sits on.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Solid cards, panels, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised or hovered surfaces, wells inside cards, table stripes.

tokens.name: surface-glass
tokens.usage: Frosted panels over the ambient field or photography; always with backdrop blur `blur-glass`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and quiet card edges. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Visible separators and table rules. Decorative; below 3:1.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and bordered buttons; at least 3:1 on bg, surface-1 and surface-2 in every theme.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface-1, surface-2 and surface-glass.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on bg, surface-1, surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and tertiary labels on bg, surface-1, surface-2 (4.5:1 minimum in every theme).

tokens.name: glow-1
tokens.usage: The brand's lead hue (Psizone teal, EQ-SYNC gold, Hemi-Sync violet, Blog teal). Ambient field, progress lines, and text on bg and surface-1.

tokens.name: glow-2
tokens.usage: Second ambient hue. Decorative only: glows, gradients, illustration; never text or meaningful marks.

tokens.name: glow-3
tokens.usage: Third ambient hue, the warm or cool counterpoint. Decorative only.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, one per view; selected states.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds for selected chips, active nav, highlighted rows.

tokens.name: ai-soft
tokens.usage: Background of anything the AI guide wrote or suggests.

tokens.name: warm-soft
tokens.usage: Warm highlight backgrounds: testimonials, human notes, stories.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset; at least 3:1 on every surface in every theme.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status text and icons, always with a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution status, always with a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, always with a word.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices.
